PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Using Brenda's clue ("She was alone with a woman."), some squares are ruled out for Albert. So Albert (A) must be at row 3, column 6. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Using Cecily's clue ("She was exactly two rows south of Duncan."), some squares are ruled out for Duncan. So Duncan (D) must be at row 4, column 1. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Brenda's clue ("She was alone with a woman.") needs a partner who does not share her row or column; that rules out squares for Brenda. So Brenda (B) must be at row 1, column 2. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Cecily that fits her clue ("She was in the Dining Hall or the Bunk Room. She was exactly two rows south of Duncan."). So Cecily (C) must be at row 6, column 5. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Elsa that fits her clue ("She was in a corner of her area."). So Elsa (E) must be at row 2, column 3. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Vince. So Vince (the victim) must be at row 5, column 4. Cross out his row and column. Duncan is the only person in the Hot Tub with Vince, so Duncan is the murderer!
